MORE:
The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e., 02nd November, 2026, inter alia, transacted the following businesses:
1. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors thereon. A copy of the Un-audited Financial Results and the Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 is enclosed herewith.
2. Based on the recommendation of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee, the Board approved Re-appointment of Ms. Pinki Dixit (DIN: 10469085) as Whole-time Director of the Company with effect from January 20, 2027 for a period of three years and payment of remuneration to her, subject to necessary consents and approvals that may be required in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including approval of the members of the Company.
